dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今日は、少し嬉しいことがあったの」
dialogues.en: "Something good really happened today."
dialogues.text: "Something good really happened today."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「嬉しいこと？　なんかあったか？」
dialogues.en: "Something good? What're you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "Something good? What're you talking about?"

dialogues.jp:
別段何かあったとは思えない。普通に起きて、
普通に飯食って、普通に音夢の熱を測って、普
通に学校に行く。
dialogues.en:
Today wasn't very different. A normal morning routine of
waking up, breakfast, measuring Nemu's temperature...
dialogues.text:
Today wasn't very different. A normal morning routine of
waking up, breakfast, measuring Nemu's temperature...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まさか、私が『兄さん、待ってよ』なんて言
　える日が来るなんて思っても見なかった……」
dialogues.en:
"I never thought I'd see the day where I'd have to say
"Nii-san, wait up!"..."
dialogues.text:
"I never thought I'd see the day where I'd have to say
"Nii-san, wait up!"..."

dialogues.jp: 音夢はそう言って、涙を拭う真似をする。
dialogues.en: She pretended to wipe away tears, mocking me further.
dialogues.text: She pretended to wipe away tears, mocking me further.

dialogues.jp:
「……失礼だな。そんな台詞、今までに何回か
　言ったことあるだろ」
dialogues.en: "...Excuuuse me. You've said that plenty of times to me."
dialogues.text: "...Excuuuse me. You've said that plenty of times to me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……そういえば、そうかも。昔、兄さんが私
　のおやつを横取りした時とか、動物園に行っ
　た時、私を置いてきぼりにした時とか」
dialogues.en:
"...That's true. Like when that time when you stole my
afternoon snack, or at the zoo when you tried to ditch me at
the playpen...
dialogues.text:
"...That's true. Like when that time when you stole my
afternoon snack, or at the zoo when you tried to ditch me at
the playpen...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「よく、そんな昔のこと覚えてるな……」
dialogues.en: "You have a memory like an elephant..."
dialogues.text: "You have a memory like an elephant..."

dialogues.jp: ちっ、と舌打ちをする。
dialogues.en: Clicking my tongue, I answered her back.
dialogues.text: Clicking my tongue, I answered her back.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ええ。兄さんのことならなんでも」
dialogues.en: "Of course, it has to do with you after all."
dialogues.text: "Of course, it has to do with you after all."

dialogues.jp:
ちっ、ちっ、と舌打ちをする。いつかそのスカ
した表情を恐怖のどん底にたたき落としてやる。
dialogues.en:
Her reply was in the same manner, down to the action. How
many times have people fallen to that terrifying face...
dialogues.text:
Her reply was in the same manner, down to the action. How
many times have people fallen to that terrifying face...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「これからも、私に｛・・・・／いい意味｝で『兄さん待って
　よ』と言わせてくださいね」
dialogues.en: "From now on, please let me say that in a good way instead."
dialogues.text: "From now on, please let me say that in a good way instead."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「気が向いたらな」
dialogues.en: "If you say so."
dialogues.text: "If you say so."

dialogues.jp:
たく、人がたまに早起きしたら、これだもんな。
やってらんないっての。
dialogues.en:
Sheesh, I wake up early for once, and I get this treatment.
Makes me not want to get up early at all.
dialogues.text:
Sheesh, I wake up early for once, and I get this treatment.
Makes me not want to get up early at all.

dialogues.jp:
ふと、隣をすたすたと通り過ぎていく小さな影
があった。
dialogues.en:
Glancing to the side, I saw a briskly-walking figure easing
past us.
dialogues.text:
Glancing to the side, I saw a briskly-walking figure easing
past us.

dialogues.jp: 「よぉ、月城」
dialogues.en: "Yo, Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "Yo, Tsukishiro."

dialogues.jp:
サラサラとした綺麗な髪の女の子がぴたりと止
まる。
dialogues.en:
Her pretty, fluttering hair came to a halt at the sound of
my voice.
dialogues.text:
Her pretty, fluttering hair came to a halt at the sound of
my voice.

dialogues.jp: 「うぃっす。こんなところで会うとは奇遇だな」
dialogues.en: "Morning. I wasn't expecting to meet you here."
dialogues.text: "Morning. I wasn't expecting to meet you here."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……おはよう、ございます」
dialogues.en: "...Good... morning."
dialogues.text: "...Good... morning."

dialogues.jp: 相変わらずのか細い声。
dialogues.en: A barely audible voice as usual.
dialogues.text: A barely audible voice as usual.

dialogues.jp:
「月城もこの時間に学校に行ってるんだな。せっ
　かくだから一緒に……」
dialogues.en:
"So you go to school at this time? Looks like we can walk to
school toget..."
dialogues.text:
"So you go to school at this time? Looks like we can walk to
school toget..."

dialogues.jp:
と言いかけると、月城はそのまま横を向き、そ
のまますたすたと早歩きで、学校に向かっていっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Before I could complete my sentence, Tsukishiro had
completely overtaken us and continued her brisk walk to
school.
dialogues.text:
Before I could complete my sentence, Tsukishiro had
completely overtaken us and continued her brisk walk to
school.

dialogues.en: "F, fast..."
dialogues.text: "F, fast..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん、今の子は？　２年生みたいだったけ
　ど……」
dialogues.en:
"Nii-san, who was that girl? She seemed like a second year
student..."
dialogues.text:
"Nii-san, who was that girl? She seemed like a second year
student..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　あ、ああ。この前ちょっと学生手帳を
　拾って届けてやったんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Mm? Ah, yeah. I found and returned her student notebook a
few days ago."
dialogues.text:
"Mm? Ah, yeah. I found and returned her student notebook a
few days ago."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ふぅん、そうなんですか。兄さんには、時々
　変わった知り合いがいますね」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm, I see. How unusual for you to make acquaintances so
easily."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm, I see. How unusual for you to make acquaintances so
easily."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「変わっているとはなんだ、変わっているとは」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by unusual, huh?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by unusual, huh?"

dialogues.jp: とはいえ、月城は……変わっている方だな。
dialogues.en: Besides, the one that's unusual is... Tsukishiro, really.
dialogues.text: Besides, the one that's unusual is... Tsukishiro, really.

dialogues.jp:
ヘンな人形は持っているし、どこか日本人離れ
した容姿だし、あの神秘的な瞳で見つめられた
ら……。
dialogues.en:
The strange doll she carries, her foreign appearance, and
those mysterious eyes always staring at something...
dialogues.text:
The strange doll she carries, her foreign appearance, and
those mysterious eyes always staring at something...

dialogues.jp:
それにあんな大きな屋敷に住んでいて、執事ま
でいて……。
dialogues.en:
And staying in that huge mansion, with a butler at her
service...
dialogues.text:
And staying in that huge mansion, with a butler at her
service...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……兄さん」
dialogues.en: "...Nii-san."
dialogues.text: "...Nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんですか？　兄さん」
dialogues.en: "..What's wrong, nii-san?"
dialogues.text: "..What's wrong, nii-san?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ？　いや」
dialogues.en: "Ah? Nothing."
dialogues.text: "Ah? Nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何度も声をかけたのに」
dialogues.en: "I called out to you so many times."
dialogues.text: "I called out to you so many times."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え？　そうだっけ？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうですよ、もう……」
dialogues.en: "Of course it is, geez..."
dialogues.text: "Of course it is, geez..."

dialogues.jp: 音夢が、ぷうっと頬を膨らませる。
dialogues.en: Nemu puffed her cheeks in exasperation.
dialogues.text: Nemu puffed her cheeks in exasperation.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、そんな顔してないで、行くぞ」
dialogues.en: "Come on, don't give me that kind of face. Let's go."
dialogues.text: "Come on, don't give me that kind of face. Let's go."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、歩幅を広げスピードをあげる。
dialogues.en: I suddenly stepped up my walking speed.
dialogues.text: I suddenly stepped up my walking speed.

dialogues.jp:
あんまりのろのろ歩いてギリギリになるんじゃ
早起きした意味がないからな。
dialogues.en:
There's no point waking up this early, only to walk like a
slug to school.
dialogues.text:
There's no point waking up this early, only to walk like a
slug to school.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、兄さん、待ってよ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, nii-san, wait up!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, nii-san, wait up!"

dialogues.jp:
音夢はそう言って、俺を追いかけて来るのだっ
た。
dialogues.en: Saying those magic words, Nemu started chasing after me.
dialogues.text: Saying those magic words, Nemu started chasing after me.

dialogues.jp: ◆兄さん、待ってよ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nii-san, Wait Up!◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nii-san, Wait Up!◆

dialogues.jp:
珍しく朝早く起きたので、音夢と一緒に登校す
る。
dialogues.en: I unusually woke up early, and accompanied Nemu to school.
dialogues.text: I unusually woke up early, and accompanied Nemu to school.

dialogues.jp:
通学路で、月城を見かけたので、声をかけたが、
小さく『おはようございます』と言われただけ
で、足早に去られてしまった。
dialogues.en:
En-route, we bumped into Tsukishiro, who whispered a simple
"Good morning" and hurried off to school.
dialogues.text:
En-route, we bumped into Tsukishiro, who whispered a simple
"Good morning" and hurried off to school.

dialogues.jp: 嫌われている訳ではないんだろうけど……。
dialogues.en: I don't think she was being rude, but...
dialogues.text: I don't think she was being rude, but...
